name: 03766 · Lebanon, NH
findings: ZIP 03766 (Lebanon) has 58 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 03766 (Lebanon) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 03766 (Lebanon) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
